title: Kononenkogroup stats
description: Figures on black down the right half of a 15-column grid: a huge 9vw grotesk number over a big serif label with an indented first line. On wide screens they rest dimmed to 20% and light up to full white on hover (0.3s); on phones they stack at full strength. Lines rise from their masks.
notes: always dark: its root carries the dark class, so it reads the theme's dark tokens even on a light page
